english: Finishers and reviving allies grant 'Ceremony' for 30 seconds, granting 30 Super. Further Finishers or ally revivals refresh the buff duration.

source.text:
2 Piece | The Ceremony

On Finisher or Ally Revival:
Initiates a Ceremony for 30 seconds.
Additional Finishers/Revivals extends the buff duration to 30 seconds.

While Ceremony is active:
+30 Super Stat.
